The earlier failed-recovery-start finding is resolved, and launcher proof has improved; final native authority proof remains incomplete. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `eb93441299262d6a5fc724477f885e6cd3dcd4b1` ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | The recovery correction and direct launcher evidence improve confidence, but the material native authority boundary remains incompletely proven. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Needs stronger real behavior proof before merge: Authority-chain proof required: real-root launcher runs establish admission fencing and v1 upgrade behavior, while published-driver Docker output establishes package-update compatibility. The changed suspension-to-systemd authority transfer is covered by synthetic transports, leaving allowed cutover and stale-custody rejection before native I/O unproven. Existing-record compatibility is supported separately by real SQLite upgrade coverage and reported focused runs. After adding proof, update the PR body; ClawSweeper should re-review automatically. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. | | **Patch quality** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Needs proof | Needs stronger real behavior proof before merge: Authority-chain proof required: real-root launcher runs establish admission fencing and v1 upgrade behavior, while published-driver Docker output establishes package-update compatibility. The changed suspension-to-systemd authority transfer is covered by synthetic transports, leaving allowed cutover and stale-custody rejection before native I/O unproven. Existing-record compatibility is supported separately by real SQLite upgrade coverage and reported focused runs. After adding proof, update the PR body; ClawSweeper should re-review automatically. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 10 items | Pinned introduction and merge composition: Reviewed the merge-base-to-head introduction. The test merge records the pinned main parent followed by the exact PR head; its finalization change preserves main's surrounding behavior.
Still necessary on main: Pinned main explicitly reports immutable activation as unavailable. The merged preparation prerequisite, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/163799, does not implement this activation/recovery slice. The immutable command file is absent from the latest release tag v2026.9.8.
Earlier recovery finding resolved: Recovery now calls the same candidate-start owner as initial activation. That owner rolls back definite readiness failures and thrown starts confirmed stopped; regression cases distinguish those outcomes from still-starting and unverified results. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | None | None. | ## How this fits together The immutable updater prepares sealed releases while the Gateway serves, then coordinates suspension and systemd lifecycle operations to select and verify a generation. Its SQLite control record retains activation and recovery facts across interruptions. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Operator consent and update request] --> B[Prepare sealed generation] B --> C[Activation control record] C --> D[Validate suspension and service custody] D --> E[Stop service and publish generation] E --> F[Start and verify Gateway] F --> G[Retire successful operation] F --> H[Protected rollback or retained recovery] ``` ## Before merge - [ ] **Add real behavior proof** - Needs stronger real behavior proof before merge: Authority-chain proof required: real-root launcher runs establish admission fencing and v1 upgrade behavior, while published-driver Docker output establishes package-update compatibility. The changed suspension-to-systemd authority transfer is covered by synthetic transports, leaving allowed cutover and stale-custody rejection before native I/O unproven. Existing-record compatibility is supported separately by real SQLite upgrade coverage and reported focused runs. After adding proof, update the PR body; ClawSweeper should re-review automatically. If it does not, the PR author or someone with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review`. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk (P1)** - The privileged suspension-to-service handoff lacks final-effect evidence through real native transport for expired/resumed suspension and revoked executor custody; the synthetic composition harness cannot establish those rejection boundaries. - [ ] **Complete next step (P2)** - Supply redacted final-effect evidence through real Gateway and native systemd owners for an allowed cutover and stale suspension or executor rejection before I/O; an isolated setup is sufficient, without a Team deployment. - [ ] **Review config compatibility** - Confirm compatibility and upgrade impact for the changed config or default surface before merge.

Migration or upgrade compatibility proof is recorded; maintainers should verify it before merge. ### Merge-risk options **Maintainer options:** 1. **Complete scoped native authority proof (recommended)** Provide redacted evidence using the real Gateway and native service owners that permits an authorized cutover and rejects stale suspension or executor custody before I/O; an isolated setup is sufficient. ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep activation opt-in and preserve the bridge and independent-recovery contracts, with verified rejection of stale custody before privileged service effects. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Not applicable to the new activation capability. The earlier recovery defect was checked against current source and its regression cases; no target code was executed during this read-only review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Yes in design: explicit activation consent reuses existing suspension, native lifecycle, readiness, and SQLite owners while preserving preparation-only installations. Scoped native authority evidence is still needed before merge. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. ([01b3d6172bb5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/01b3d6172bb5cf4959eb3ce41ea52ddf0fc86b5c)) - **Still necessary on main:** Pinned main explicitly reports immutable activation as unavailable. ([`src/cli/update-cli/update-command-immutable.ts:11`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/4ab382220e2cca1deedb2c2549982f91c0fb5c64/src/cli/update-cli/update-command-immutable.ts#L11), [4ab382220e2c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4ab382220e2cca1deedb2c2549982f91c0fb5c64)) - **Earlier recovery finding resolved:** Recovery now calls the same candidate-start owner as initial activation. That owner rolls back definite readiness failures and thrown starts confirmed stopped; regression cases distinguish those outcomes from still-starting and unverified results. ([`src/infra/update-immutable-activation.ts:518`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/eb93441299262d6a5fc724477f885e6cd3dcd4b1/src/infra/update-immutable-activation.ts#L518), [eb9344129926](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eb93441299262d6a5fc724477f885e6cd3dcd4b1)) - **Complete captured proof body inspected:** The full GitHub body was read and its SHA-256 matched the captured snapshot: 2c8649f7a480f22006cf0881729ed74ade030035252c897bc12000eba6babc35. It reports nine real-root launcher passes, including execve, blocked supervisor replacement, hot-journal preservation, and exact-v1 backup/upgrade. These directly exercise launcher admission; they do not exercise native systemd activation. ([`src/infra/update-immutable-launcher.test.ts:261`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/eb93441299262d6a5fc724477f885e6cd3dcd4b1/src/infra/update-immutable-launcher.test.ts#L261), [eb9344129926](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eb93441299262d6a5fc724477f885e6cd3dcd4b1)) - **Native final-effect coverage gap:** The native composition harness replaces Gateway RPC, the systemd broker, systemctl, and process observations. Its expiry/resume, write-custody, replacement-process, and lost-reply cases are useful supplemental regressions, but cannot establish rejection before real native I/O. ([`src/cli/update-cli/update-command-service-drain.native.test.ts:48`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/eb93441299262d6a5fc724477f885e6cd3dcd4b1/src/cli/update-cli/update-command-service-drain.native.test.ts#L48), [eb9344129926](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eb93441299262d6a5fc724477f885e6cd3dcd4b1)) - **Changed privileged dispatch boundary:** Committed suspension transfers authority into one-way host shutdown, while the native broker invokes the new effect guard immediately before sd-bus dispatch. This material authority transfer makes allowed and stale-custody final-effect evidence relevant. ([`src/daemon/systemd-peer-native.ts:366`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/eb93441299262d6a5fc724477f885e6cd3dcd4b1/src/daemon/systemd-peer-native.ts#L366), [eb9344129926](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eb93441299262d6a5fc724477f885e6cd3dcd4b1)) Likely related people: - **steipete:** Suggested for follow-up; no historical authorship or introduction is verified. (role: unverified routing candidate; confidence: low) - **Sebastien Tardif:** Suggested for follow-up; no historical authorship or introduction is verified. (role: unverified routing candidate; confidence: low) ### Rank-up moves Optional improvements that raise the rating; they are not merge blockers. - Add final-effect evidence for an authorized native cutover and rejection of expired/resumed suspension or revoked executor custody before I/O. Redact private details; updating the PR body should trigger re-review, or a maintainer can request @clawsweeper re-review. ### Rating scale | Score | Internal tier | Crab rank | Meaning | |---:|:---:|---|---| | **6/6** | S | 🦀 challenger crab | Exceptional readiness | | **5/6** | A | 🦞 diamond lobster | Very strong readiness | | **4/6** | B | 🐚 platinum hermit | Good normal PR; ordinary maintainer review | | **3/6** | C | 🦐 gold shrimp | Useful, but confidence is limited | | **2/6** | D | 🦪 silver shellfish | Proof or implementation needs work | | **1/6** | F | 🧂 unranked krab | Not merge-ready | | N/A | NA | 🌊 off-meta tidepool | Rating does not apply | Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality. Shiny media proof means a screenshot, video, or linked artifact directly shows the changed behavior. Runtime, network, CSP, and security claims still need visible diagnostics. ### Workflow - ClawSweeper keeps one durable marker-backed review comment per issue or PR. - Re-runs edit this comment so the latest verdict, findings, and automation markers stay together instead of adding duplicate bot comments. - A fresh review can be triggered by eligible `@clawsweeper re-review` comments, exact-item GitHub events, scheduled/background review runs, or manual workflow dispatch. - PR/issue authors and users with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review` or `@clawsweeper re-run` on an open PR or issue to request a fresh review only. - Maintainers can also comment `@clawsweeper review` to request a fresh review only. - Fresh-review commands do not start repair, autofix, rebase, CI repair, or automerge. - Maintainer-only repair and merge flows require explicit commands such as `@clawsweeper autofix`, `@clawsweeper automerge`, `@clawsweeper fix ci`, or `@clawsweeper address review`. - Maintainers can comment `@clawsweeper explain` to ask for more context, or `@clawsweeper stop` to stop active automation. ### History
